text.content: Is melding at odds with decoupling? Decoupling is the ability to separate eg an idea from its context, or an idea from its speaker. I think that a high-decoupling discussion or argument would be one in which the participants treat it as the sport of debate. But maybe this denies some kind of fundamental important emotional meld between a speaker and the idea that they represent.
